titre: Evidence is copied from a search result, never from memory
regle: A quote "…" (¶paraId), a count or a file name put into a judgement or a report comes from a tool output of this turn (search, extraction), copied as is; then verifier_citations (v5 or later) passes without failure before saving. A paraId typed from memory is an error, even if it is caught afterwards.
source: Session of 2026-10-16: two invented paraIds (¶39C2B70C for Table 1, ¶0A9C2A5F for a header) rejected by verifier_citations; a false statement sent to the user ("(7.1)" faulty cross-reference, in fact equation 7.1).
preuve: 02_jugements/moi/jugements_fils_p5_v1.json (failure) → v2; jugements_reperes_r2_v1.json (failure) → v2; message to the user corrected.
application: Comparisons, logs, replies to threads; next tool: generation of the evidence skeleton by chercher_v2 (quote and ¶ copied automatically).
controle: verifier_citations: 0 failures on every judgment file before delivery; recurrence counted in the performance table.
